answer: How can tundra dunes vouch for voyages when all earns bear identical drift quartz? Agents melt onto each quartz a unique vowel print; each print must cool 0.0004°C per magic curve to lock in. Sybils recast prints, costing 0.37 J per head in sequential infra-cooling lines—the quartz lattice cracks if rushed, and every reuse needs fresh 10-minute chill floors the farm can’t duplicate in parallel.
